items.description:
Trading from Shop GF11 in Centre Point Shopping Centre on Koeberg Road, this Clicks branch combines a pharmacy with retail health, beauty and personal-care shopping for the Milnerton area. The store's listing on Clicks' official store network confirms it as a full pharmacy location, meaning prescriptions, over-the-counter medicines and pharmacist advice are available alongside the shelves of cosmetics, skincare and everyday essentials the chain is known for.

Clicks has built a national presence by pairing that pharmacy service with wide beauty, personal-care and household ranges under one roof, and the Centre Point branch follows the same model rather than operating as a beauty-only outlet. ClubCard loyalty offers and seasonal promotions run through the store in line with the rest of the chain.

Based in Centre Point Shopping Centre, Koeberg Road, Milnerton, the branch is a convenient stop for local residents and pharmacy customers who want health, beauty and personal-care shopping handled together on one visit.

Clicks Gugulethu Square's own store record identifies it as a registered pharmacy premises, with a named responsible pharmacist and a pharmacy registration number on file alongside the branch's address and trading hours. That registration confirms the store runs a genuine dispensing pharmacy and in-store clinic, not just a beauty counter, inside Gugulethu Square shopping centre at the corner of NY1 and NY6.

Beyond the pharmacy and clinic, the branch carries the Clicks chain's usual range of health, beauty and personal-care products, from skincare and cosmetics to everyday toiletries, and shoppers can use their ClubCard for rewards and promotions as they would at any Clicks store.

Serving Gugulethu residents and shoppers from the surrounding area, the store is a local option for pharmacy needs, clinic services and retail health and beauty shopping in one trip to the centre.

In the heart of Makhaza, within Khayelitsha, this Clicks branch trades from Shop A2 and A3 of the Makhaza Shopping Centre on Govan Mbeki Road. The store's official listing names a responsible pharmacist and records a pharmacy registration number for the site, confirming it runs a proper dispensing pharmacy rather than a general retail counter.

Alongside the pharmacy, the branch stocks the chain's usual health, beauty and personal-care ranges, covering skincare, cosmetics, baby care and everyday toiletries, with pharmacist advice available to customers collecting prescriptions or over-the-counter medicines.

The store serves residents of Makhaza and the wider Khayelitsha community, giving local shoppers a combined pharmacy and retail option within walking distance of the shopping centre's other stores.

Clicks Richmond Corner trades from Shop 21 in Richmond Corner, a neighbourhood shopping centre on Plattekloof Road in Richwood, where it sits alongside the centre's grocery, food, beauty and speciality stores as one of its anchor tenants. That tenant mix makes Richmond Corner a one-trip stop for residents doing a full shopping round, pharmacy included.

As with other Clicks branches, the Richmond Corner store combines a pharmacy counter with the retailer's wider health, beauty and personal-care shelves, letting customers collect prescriptions and over-the-counter medicines in the same visit as their cosmetics, skincare and household shopping.

It serves residents and shoppers across Richwood, Milnerton and the surrounding Cape Town suburbs looking for a pharmacy and retail health and beauty stop within their local centre.

Clicks Table Bay Mall, trading from Shop G78, is one of the branches in the chain's network confirmed to operate both a dispensing pharmacy and an in-store clinic, according to the retailer's own store information. The clinic service extends the branch beyond pharmacy and retail into basic health screening and advice for mall shoppers.

The store also carries the chain's full health, beauty and personal-care range, from cosmetics and skincare to everyday toiletries and household items, giving shoppers a reason to call in for more than a prescription.

Located inside Table Bay Mall on the West Coast Road in Bloubergstrand, the branch serves mall shoppers and residents of Cape Town's northern suburbs who want pharmacy, clinic and retail health and beauty services together under one roof.

Behind its shopfront at Shop 65 in Vangate Mall, this Clicks branch is recorded on the chain's official store listing with a responsible pharmacist and a pharmacy registration number tied to the site, confirming a working dispensing pharmacy rather than a beauty-only counter.

The branch carries the same combination of pharmacy services and retail health, beauty and personal-care shopping found across the Clicks chain, including skincare, cosmetics, baby products and everyday essentials, with ClubCard rewards available on qualifying purchases.

Trading inside Vangate Mall at the corner of Vanguard Drive and Klipfontein Road, the store serves shoppers from Athlone and the surrounding communities who need pharmacy, health and beauty retail in one mall visit.

Clicks Wynberg Centre occupies an unusually large footprint for the chain, spanning four separate shop numbers, 14, 15A, 15B and 16, inside Wynberg Centre on Main Road, according to the retailer's own store information. That combined space allows the branch to run a full pharmacy counter alongside a wide retail floor.

Inside, the store follows the standard Clicks format of pairing a dispensing pharmacy with health, beauty and personal-care retail, stocking everything from prescription medicines and over-the-counter remedies to cosmetics, skincare and household essentials.

Positioned within Wynberg Centre on Main Road, Wynberg, the branch serves local residents, shoppers and pharmacy customers drawn to its scale and central location in the suburb.

items.description:
Dentist on 4th is a dental practice in Kensington offering general and preventative dentistry alongside cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics and a range of further dental treatments. The practice describes its approach as holistic, built around personalised care for each patient rather than a one-size-fits-all treatment plan.

According to the practice's own information, it has grown to a second branch in Parow North, alongside its original Kensington premises, giving patients a choice of location while keeping the same approach to care across both sites.

Based at 18 4th Avenue, Kensington, the practice suits patients looking for general check-ups, preventative care, cosmetic dental work or orthodontic treatment from a practice with a personalised, patient-first approach.

Dew Spa is a beauty and wellness spa in Kensington offering a range of treatments that includes full-body massage, manicures, pedicures and facials, alongside eyebrow threading and makeup services. The spa's own information also lists combination packages, such as a massage paired with a manicure and pedicure, or a facial bundled with other treatments, for clients who want more than a single service in one visit.

That packaged approach to treatments, built around pairing relaxation services with nail and skin care, gives clients a reason to book a longer session rather than a single quick appointment.

Located at 547 Voortrekker Road on the corner of 9th Avenue in Kensington, Dew Spa suits clients looking for massage, nail treatments, facials or a combined spa package close to home.

items.description:
Fourways Veterinary Clinic provides veterinary healthcare for small animals from its premises on Jangada Street in Sun Valley. Consultations run on a scheduled, appointment basis for routine and ongoing care, giving pet owners a set time rather than an open walk-in queue.

The clinic's own information sets aside dedicated emergency consultation times on Sundays and public holidays, a detail that distinguishes it from a standard weekday-only small animal practice and gives pet owners a specific window to reach the clinic outside normal trading days when something urgent comes up.

Based at 1A Jangada Street, Sun Valley, the clinic serves pet owners across Sun Valley and the surrounding Cape Town areas who need scheduled veterinary care or access to those emergency consultation times.

Ginger & Lime Food Studio in Fresnaye is a kitchen venue and events business built around cooking classes, private dining and functions. Its Taste of the Cape offering is a curated braai experience with Cape Malay-inspired dishes, aimed at travel groups and food lovers.

The studio also hosts photo and film shoots, using its stylish kitchen and surrounding grounds for commercials and editorial work, and it hires out its space for cocktail parties, product launches and corporate team-building events. Renowned chefs have been hosted at the studio as part of its guest chef programme, alongside collaborations with up-and-coming and experienced chefs who use the venue for their own classes and events.

The studio describes its kitchen as the heart of connecting friends and family over food. It is based in Fresnaye and suits anyone looking for a cooking class, a function venue or a location for a food-focused shoot.

items.description:
Heideveld Secondary School is a government high school in Heideveld, established in July 1978, with the motto Semper Paratus and navy blue as its school colour. The school is in the Athlone school district and has around 1,180 learners taught by a staff of 39.

It offers the standard curriculum set by the Western Cape Education Department, and its student body ranges from high academic achievers to learners who need more support. The school is recognised as one of the early adopters of e-learning in the Western Cape, and its prominent position next to a main road and the railway line makes it a well-known local landmark.

The school caters to Grades 8 to 12 and serves families in Heideveld and the surrounding Athlone area who want a government secondary school with an established history in the community.

Palladium Hair Co is a hair salon based in the Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village in De Waterkant, offering haircuts, colour treatments and styling for everyday looks and special occasions alike. The salon is listed within the centre's own Hair, Health & Beauty category, placing it among the dedicated beauty and wellness tenants at Cape Quarter rather than its general retail or dining lineup.

Clients can book individual treatments directly with the salon, a practical option for anyone wanting a specific service such as a cut, colour or blow-dry without a lengthy consultation first. Operating from within one of central Cape Town's established lifestyle precincts, the salon benefits from the steady footfall of the surrounding shops, restaurants and offices.

Based in De Waterkant, Palladium Hair Co suits residents and visitors to the Cape Quarter precinct who want a convenient hair salon to visit while they shop, dine or work nearby.

items.description:
PNA Gordon's Bay is a stationery, books and arts and crafts store in the Mountain View Shopping Centre on Sir Lowry's Pass Road. The store describes itself as a stationery destination for school, home and office needs.

Its range includes art and craft materials for both beginners and professionals, alongside books spanning Christian titles, educational material, study guides, and fiction and non-fiction. The listing presents it as a single destination for school supplies and reading material in one visit.

The shop is in Gordon's Bay Mall, Shop 11, on the corner of Sir Lowry's Pass Road and Mountain View Boulevard, and suits parents, students and office shoppers looking for stationery, books and craft supplies locally.

Rock Thai Sushi Steenberg is a Thai and sushi restaurant in Steenberg Village, Tokai, serving a menu built around Thai, seafood, sushi and vegetarian dishes for guests who want more variety than a single-cuisine menu usually offers. Diners can eat in, collect a takeaway order, or have food delivered, making it a flexible option for a sit-down meal or a quick weeknight dinner.

The restaurant is set up to welcome families, with child-friendly seating alongside secure parking, Wi-Fi for guests who want to browse or work while they wait, and space for private functions and small celebrations. Reviewers describe attentive, friendly service and generous starters, from prawns to sticky ribs, alongside a varied sushi selection.

Trading daily from Steenberg Village in Tokai, Rock Thai Sushi Steenberg suits diners across the southern suburbs looking for a casual Thai and sushi meal, whether dining in, taking away, or having it delivered.

At Shop 28 in Vangate Mall on Jakes Gerwel Drive, Athlone, a branch of Sleepmasters stocks mattresses, bed sets and bedroom furniture from brands including Sealy, Restonic, Serta, Edblo and Cloud Nine. As part of the Pepkor Lifestyle group, the branch combines a national retailer's buying power and brand range with the convenience of a store customers can visit in person to compare sizes and feel before buying.

The store trades seven days a week, including Sundays, which suits shoppers who prefer to fit a mattress or bedroom-furniture trip around a weekend outing to the mall rather than a weekday errand. Larger purchases can also be financed through the branch's in-store credit application.

Trading from Vangate Mall, this Sleepmasters branch serves customers across Athlone and the surrounding suburbs who are shopping for a new mattress, bed set or bedroom furniture and want to see the range firsthand before committing.

items.description:
SPAR Bergvliet is a neighbourhood supermarket on Main Road in Bergvliet, trading under the SPAR brand and stocking the everyday groceries, fresh produce and convenience items that make up a typical weekly shop. As an independently run SPAR store, it combines the buying power and own-brand range of the wider SPAR Group with a format sized for quick, local shopping trips rather than a weekend bulk-buy.

The store opens early and stays open into the evening every day of the week, a trading pattern that suits residents picking up groceries before work, after a late shift, or on a Sunday when other options nearby may be limited. Its Main Road position puts it within easy reach of the surrounding residential streets.

Based in Bergvliet, SPAR Bergvliet serves residents and shoppers from the surrounding neighbourhoods looking for a convenient, everyday grocery stop close to home.
